condition_history.detail: scroll with order_by: next_page_offset always null even when limit < total (200 pts, limit 70 -> only 70 retrievable, silent truncation). Control: without order_by next_page_offset=71 -> full 200 walk. offset cursor explicitly forbidden with order_by (400), so no paging mechanism at all.
condition_history.inspired_by: order_by discovery during endpoint expansion (contract order_by param on scroll)

condition_history.detail: integer range value on datetime field silently accepted (200): indexed datetime interprets int as epoch MICROseconds (1767312000000000 == '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z', both 193), unindexed datetime with same int NEVER matches (0) — same request divergent semantics by index presence. Doc: datetime range supports RFC3339 only.
condition_history.inspired_by: round-1 type_mismatch finding -> adjacent: numeric literal on datetime field, indexed vs unindexed

condition_history.detail: score_threshold uses strict >: the server-reported top score fed back as score_threshold excludes the point (th==S: n=0 on search/query/recommend/groups; th==S-0.01: n=1). Docs phrase the option as 'cut off results with less than a threshold' — equal scores must be kept. f32 score rounding makes th=S-1e-9 also exclude (threshold rounds back to S).
condition_history.control: threshold clearly below (S-0.01) returns the top point on every endpoint
condition_history.inspired_by: GT-informed 续挖 hint 参数/边界 -> param-sweep on query family shared params

Contract lists them (quotas+get/set, locks+get/set) with schemas and behavioral constraints ('node-wide quotas replacing deprecated strict-mode max_resident_memory_percent').

condition_history.inspired_by: contract endpoint enumeration (77 endpoints) — service section untested in rounds 1-2

condition_history.detail: f64->f32 silent overflow: upsert accepts vector components up to f64 max (1e300 -> 200); storage is f32 (max 3.4028235e38) so values become +inf. Read-back returns vector [null,null,null,null]; a NORMAL query ranks the corrupted point FIRST with score null (schema: score is a number); oversized query vector makes all scores null; boundary sweep pins transition exactly at f32::MAX (3.4028235e38 one null, 3.5e38 all null). Reproduces on Cosine/Dot/Euclid.
condition_history.control: ordinary points in the same responses keep numeric scores; read-back of normal point returns real components
condition_history.inspired_by: bug_shapes type_confusion + numeric_boundary — JSON f64 parse vs f32 storage seam

condition_history.detail: Fractional range bounds on INDEXED integer field are floor-truncated: gte 2.5 returns num=2 (out of range), lt 7.5 drops num=7. Exact==scroll (core filter engine, not estimator family). Unindexed same-data field compares correctly -> bug specific to indexed path. Float field fractional bounds correct; fractional match value 400-rejected (strict).
condition_history.control: gt 2.5 -> [3..9] and gte 2.0 -> [2..9] bracket the correct gte 2.5 answer (3..9); unindexed num2 field returns correct ids
condition_history.inspired_by: threat_model vector #13 (issue 9049 KNOWN_ISSUE) + round-1 range_filter finding feedback

condition_history.detail: filter.min_should {conditions:[], min_count:1} silently degrades to MATCH-ALL (entire collection returned, 200). Unsatisfiable by definition. min_count=0 empty = legit no-op; real-condition min_should correct (min2 -> [8], min1 -> union).
condition_history.inspired_by: threat_model vector #8 (issue 9369 PARTIALLY_FIXED) + BS-04 min_should hint

PATCH cannot rescue: VectorsConfigDiff rejects {size:4,...} (no size field in diff schema) -> permanently unusable.
condition_history.control: normal create on same server accepts upserts (200); scroll/count on broken collection return 200 empty (zombie green state)

condition_history.detail: Vector validation skipped on ALL async (wait=false) write paths: empty [] / wrong-dim (3,5) / named-empty vectors -> 200 acknowledged then silently dropped (never land; vector unchanged). Identical payloads wait=true -> 400 with precise dimension error. By_design note: wait=false error-visibility entry covers 'fails later, logs only'; the structural finding is the wait=true-only validation asymmetry across 3 endpoints.
condition_history.control: valid upsert wait=false lands and readable (async path works); each invalid payload 400s with wait=true
condition_history.inspired_by: threat_model vector #3 (issue 9045 Critical STILL_VULNERABLE) - panic gone in 1.18.0, illegal-success remains

condition_history.detail: Filter clause typing silently lenient: should=null / all-null clauses -> 200 (null==absent, no-filter semantics); must/should/must_not as OBJECT (schema: array) -> 200 silently coerced to [object]. Semantics preserved but schema violations never 4xx; typo'd null should-clause executes as no-filter.
condition_history.control: valid equivalents ({} -> 10, must[cat=a] -> 7) match; siblings still honored (must+should:null -> 7)
